SSC 10+2 CHSL Post Preference Cum Option Form 2026 : Important Question

Question: What is the SSC CHSL Post Preference Cum Option Form 2026? Answer: It is an online form through which candidates select their preferred posts and departments for final appointment under the SSC CHSL recruitment process.

Question: Who is required to fill the Post Preference Cum Option Form? Answer: All eligible candidates who are instructed by SSC to submit their post preferences must fill out the Option Cum Preference Form within the prescribed period.

Question: How can I fill the SSC CHSL Post Preference Form 2026? Answer: Visit the official SSC website, log in to your candidate account, open the Option Cum Preference link under My Application , select your preferred posts/departments in order of priority, and submit the form.

Question: Can I change my post preferences after submitting the form? Answer: Yes. You can modify your preferences during the submission window. However, the last submitted preferences before the deadline will be treated as final .

SSC 10+2 CHSL 2025 FRTA Result

Post Date: August 17, 2026

6:56 pm

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the FRTA Result on its official website for the recruitment of the CHSL (10+2) Examination 2026. The Tier-II re-exam will be conducted on 22 April 2026 (rescheduled), and the last date to submit the application form was 18 July 2025. Candidates can also check their FRTA Result using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link is provided below.
